data.name: Privacy_Body
data.value:
TravelPlanner respects your privacy. In short: your data stays on your device.
What is stored? Your trips, plans, expenses, to-dos, saved places, participant names and the documents/photos you add are stored only in the app's storage on this device. There is no account, sign-up or cloud server; we cannot see this data.
What is sent over the internet? The app only contacts these free services, when you use the related feature: • Open-Meteo: weather and city search (city name, coordinates). • Photon (komoot): place search and the name of a point picked on the map (search text, coordinates). • OpenFreeMap: map images (the area shown). • Frankfurter: exchange rates (currency pair, date). Like any internet request, these services can see your IP address. No personal information (your name, expenses, documents) is sent.
Permissions The camera and photos are used only when you choose to add a document or photo. Notifications are scheduled on the device (trip reminders, budget alerts).
Ads, analytics, tracking The app contains no ads, no analytics and no user tracking.
Backups and sharing Backup (.zip) and PDF files are created only when you ask and are sent only where you choose (e.g. Files, Drive, e-mail).
Deleting data Uninstalling the app deletes all of its data from the device. You can delete individual trips inside the app.
For questions, please use the developer contact address on the store page.

Your account will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone:
• Trips you own, everything in them and their documents are deleted from the cloud; people you shared them with lose access. • You are removed from trips shared with you. • The account's data on this device is deleted and the app continues as a guest.
If you want a copy of your trips, export a backup first (Backup → Export).
